fields.System.Title: CNT-303 — Approve and post the adjustment
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an inventory controller, I want an approved variance to correct the stock figure, so
that the system matches the shelf.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given an approved variance, when it is posted, then the balance is corrected, a
  • movement to or from a virtual location is written with a count reason code, and the count task
  • closes — in one transaction.
  • - Given a variance above the approval threshold, then it requires a supervisor, and the
  • counter cannot approve their own.
  • - Given the same posting sent twice with one idempotency key, then the balance changes
  • once.
  • - Given posting, then the adjustment links back to the count task and the count result.
  • - Given posting, then counting.adjustment_posted is published so the ERP learns of the
  • financial impact.
  • - Given stock at that location with reservations, then affected orders are re-checked.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | counting, inventory, outbound |
| Tables | variance, adjustment, stock_balance, stock_movement, outbox |
| Risks | Adjustment posted twice ([doc 09 §3.2](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); invalidating an allocation ([doc 09 §4.5](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · idempotency · rollback · invariant |
